741667ae-d564-4e22-8b2f-091bc19bb360.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and maintainable software applications. The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience building production systems, and the ability to make sound technical decisions while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

The Senior Software Engineer will be involved in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, implementation, testing, code review, deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

Responsibilities:
- Design and develop scalable, secure, and maintainable software applications.
- Translate business and technical requirements into effective software solutions.
- Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services.
- Develop and maintain frontend applications when required.
- Design and optimize relational and/or NoSQL database structures.
- Write clean, efficient, testable, and maintainable code.
- Perform code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback.
- Investigate and resolve complex production issues and software defects.
- Improve application performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
- Implement automated testing and contribute to software quality practices.
- Work with DevOps engineers to improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
- Participate in system architecture and technical design discussions.
- Collaborate with Product Managers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and other stakeholders.
- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior and mid-level engineers.
- Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and development best practices.
